documents.title: Social media guidance
documents.text:
For Atlas Parts, LinkedIn posts should explain product applications before promotional calls to action.

Avoid unsupported durability claims in automotive content.

documents.title: Product catalogue
documents.text:
Product catalogue items include filters and brake components.

Specifications must be checked against the official product sheet.

documents.title: Instagram guidelines
documents.text:
For Northstar Events, Instagram captions should use a warm, concise tone.

Do not promise unconfirmed event dates.

documents.title: Channel scope
documents.text: LinkedIn publishing is not part of the current Northstar Events editorial scope.
